B.strength: Summary line plus BD bullets labeled Kinematics/Dynamics match the listing, backed by a rigorous EKF verification story
B.weakness: Skills sit at the bottom; informal bullet labels ('Proved it before trusting it')

D.weakness: Dense, keyword-heavy page; 'developing rigid-body kinematics and dynamics for Atlas' slightly overclaims

F.strength: BD Atlas co-op and C++ PI controller still visible
F.weakness: Simplified bullets, legged EKF/QP project buried last as one line, hobbies, no portfolio link, no testing evidence

G.strength: Fullest project detail (EKF verification, trot tracking, QP error cut 0.169 to 0.091 m/s)

notes: The top versions (B, D, A) show kinematics/dynamics, control and estimation in the first third of the page and back them with verified C++ EKF and PI-control detail. The bottom versions bury that work under a dashboard-first lead (C), mechanical padding (E), or simplified bullets and hobbies (F).
